Data sources (single verbatim read): "Annual and ozone season unit-level heat input for eGRID is initially obtained from the reported emissions data" (EPA/CAPD, i.e. 40 CFR Part 75) and, when not reported, "annual and ozone heat input data are obtained at the unit level or prime mover level from the EIA-923 monthly data". The HHV basis therefore rests on the two source definitions below.

basis.boundary: Acid Rain Program / Part 75 heat input

values.source_title: 40 CFR 72.2 Definitions (Acid Rain Program)
values.publisher: U.S. EPA / Office of the Federal Register (eCFR)
values.locator: §72.2, definition 'Heat input rate'
values.quote1: Heat input rate means the product (expressed in mmBtu/hr) of the gross calorific value of the fuel (expressed in mmBtu/mass of fuel) and the fuel feed rate into the combustion device (expressed in mass of fuel/hr) and does not include the heat derived from preheated combustion air, recirculated flue gases, or exhaust from other sources.
values.quote2: Heat input rate means the product (expressed in mmBtu/hr) of the gross calorific value of the fuel  [LII mirror https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/40/72.2]
values.notes: Second read from Cornell LII mirror of the same section; overlapping text identical. Neither read found a standalone 'Heat input' or 'GCV' definition in the text window returned.

values.locator: entry 'Heat content' note
values.quote1: The Energy Information Administration typically uses gross heat content values.
values.quote2: The Energy Information Administration typically uses gross heat content values.

rejected.reason: Read off a bar chart (Figure ES-1) by the summariser; numbers not printed as text, labels inferred from bar order; AR4 (2007) GWPs; superseded report. Not verbatim -> rejected.
Single unit process (one underground Illinois No. 6 mine), methane only, excludes transport and upstream energy, no GWP; single read. Not a WTT intensity -> rejected.
AR5 results are only in Appendix E (release package spreadsheet); not in the PDF text and the EDX file list did not load. Only a relative statement exists (32% decrease vs 2017 on AR5 basis).

gaps: Coal upstream (mining + transport) for US power-plant coal: no free US-government or CARB source readable via WebFetch gives it as verbatim text. 3B/3C-up/3D-up coal term stays unmapped (held / partial), never zero.
Residual fuel oil, kerosene/jet fuel upstream: not in CA-GREET3.0 LUT TSD (2018); no federal readable source. Jet fuel appears in the CA-GREET3.0 supplemental doc only as tailpipe (Table 1).

CA-GREET3.0 heating-value basis: not stated in any CARB document read (LUT TSD, supplemental doc, 15-day Attachment C, ISOR, FRO first 100k chars). LHV is the GREET convention but is unverified; applying these g/MJ values to HHV gallons/MMBtu needs a cited LHV/HHV bridge.
CA-GREET3.0 GWP set: not stated; inferred AR4 (CH4 25, N2O 298) from printed table arithmetic (cagreet3.gwp_inferred). Different from Scope 1/2 register (AR5) and from NETL (AR6).
NETL natural gas AR5 values (Appendix E): not obtained; register 7.8/8.8 as AR6 with explicit gwp_set and disclose the mix, or stage the appendix spreadsheet.
CBECS: heat content EIA used to convert natural gas cubic feet is not stated in C24 or the guide page; RSE tab (xlsx) not read.

Hotel Table 5: values are per AVAILABLE room-night (annual/365, no occupancy adjustment) from 2005-vintage data; the events guidance citation date ('December 2015') conflicts with the CHP report cover ('December 2005').
